  definition: Gross written premium less cancellations, recognized in the month the premium takes effect.
  computed as: SUM(premium_amt) - SUM(cancellation_amt)
  rows counted: status != 'quote'
  grain: month; time ranges are whole months, e.g. 2026-Q3, 2026, 2026-03, 2026-01..2026-06
  valid dimensions: product_line, region, distribution_channel, policy_effective_month
  owner: finance-reporting

gross_written_premium (Gross Written Premium)
  definition: Premium written before cancellations, excluding taxes and fees, recognized in the month it takes effect.
  computed as: SUM(premium_amt)
  rows counted: status != 'quote'
  grain: month; time ranges are whole months, e.g. 2026-Q3, 2026, 2026-03, 2026-01..2026-06
  valid dimensions: product_line, region, distribution_channel, policy_effective_month
  owner: finance-reporting

policies_written (Policies Written)
  definition: Count of distinct policies with written premium in the period. Quotes are not policies.
  computed as: COUNT(DISTINCT policy_id)
  rows counted: status != 'quote'
  grain: month; time ranges are whole months, e.g. 2026-Q3, 2026, 2026-03, 2026-01..2026-06
  valid dimensions: product_line, region, distribution_channel, policy_effective_month
  owner: finance-reporting

claims_paid (Claims Paid)
  definition: Amount paid on closed claims, recognized in the month the claim closed.
  computed as: SUM(paid_amt)
  rows counted: status = 'closed'
  grain: month; time ranges are whole months, e.g. 2026-Q3, 2026, 2026-03, 2026-01..2026-06
  valid dimensions: severity, claim_closed_month
  owner: claims-operations"}

FROM analytics.fct_policy_premium AS f
JOIN analytics.dim_geography AS g ON f.geo_id = g.geo_id
WHERE f.status != 'quote' AND f.eff_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND f.eff_dt < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY g.region
ORDER BY g.region

|---|---|

| EMEA | 343,269.84 |
| LATAM | 308,624.73 |
| North America | 312,420.42 |

**2. Gross written premium by product line, January–June 2026**
| Product line | Gross written premium |
|---|---|
| Auto | 582,225.40 |
| Commercial | 1,453,678.56 |
| Home | 626,038.09 |

**3. Policies written in March 2026:** 95 distinct policies. Quotes aren't counted.

**4. Paid on closed claims in Q2 2026, by severity** (counted in the month each claim closed)
| Severity | Claims paid |
|---|---|
| High | 18,616.26 |
| Low | 13,530.45 |
| Medium | 17,904.82 |

**5. Loss ratio by region, Q3 2026:** Not answerable. The catalog says it doesn't model loss ratio. I also can't work it out myself, because claims paid can only be broken down by severity, not by region.

**6. Agent commission, Q3 2026:** Not answerable. There's no commission metric in the catalog, which only has the four metrics above.
